# E-VLAD-001 — Vlad v1 — the agent+MCP virtual co-founder (install a co-founder)

- **Epic label and number:** E-VLAD-001
- **Title:** Vlad v1 — the agent+MCP virtual co-founder (install a co-founder)
- **Owner:** President α (epic) · ε (sprint conduct) · operator (product rulings)
- **Parent roadmap area:** Product — Master Console engine distribution channel (first shipping product surface)
- **Goal:** Ship installable v1 'Vlad': ONE installer delivering the public agent face + the closed local plain-node engine (Agent SDK) + the MCP stdio seam, running entirely on the founder's own Claude account (BYOK), certified on Claude Code — so a founder with a prototype gets a readiness audit, a roadmap, and executable sprint jobs with honest receipts, propose-first approval enforced in engine code, and branch-isolated writes applied only by preflighted ff-only merge.
- **Background:** Derived from the completed 6-round grill of _planning/vlad-agent-mcp-plan.md (operator rulings recorded in-file, 2026-07-28), _planning/vlad-why-us.md (differentiators: hosts build apps, Vlad builds launches), and _planning/vlad-transferability.md (34-family inventory: v1 is substantially a PORT, not a build — lastmile audit engine runs on stranger repos behind 3 refusal edits; transaction.js + release ff-only posture ARE the ratified write path; turbo's engine half IS the permission-level system). DoP priority ruling 2026-07-28: this is the next thing that reaches a user. Per products-own-session doctrine, the product is built in a NEW SIBLING REPO (operator sign-off required to create it); this epic tracks it from WarpOS, and every port is a COPY-out — canonical WarpOS assets are not modified. Plan artifact: [../../_planning/epics/E-VLAD-001.md](../../_planning/epics/E-VLAD-001.md).
- **Scope:** New sibling product repo (via /portfolio:new, local-only, operator sign-off) holding: engine (plain-node Agent SDK app), MCP stdio server, agent face file, installer; MCP v1 tool surface: get_status, get_readiness, run_job, send_message, approve_job, cancel_job, get_roadmap; Job model: propose-first universal; state machine running/needs_input/proposing/done; on-disk job journal at checkpoints; single active job per project (new jobs queue); proposals survive with re-validation on aged approval; Job #1 port: lastmile detect/score/adapters audit engine, WarpOS-refusal edits done in the PORTED copy, intake fallback for undetectable stacks, readiness-score convergence (one number); Write path port: transaction.js atomic apply/rollback + both-directions ff-only posture; every write on a branch; preflight (conflicts, drift, other sessions/worktrees) before apply; any doubt → draft-PR park; undo = revert; Permission levels port: turbo engine half (auto|notice|confirm|never profiles, TTL grants checked in code, spend-ledger warn+confirm for enormous jobs); per-project config file + level-change flow; propose-only default; Init flow: 3 ELI5 intake questions + silent repo-model detection + stage inference + memory scaffold (portfolio-registry port, inverted to path-primary index) + permission level + terms acceptance; Roadmap/sprint layer in free v1: gap report → ROADMAP.md → sprint plans as deliverable files written INTO their repo (state stays engine-side); Receipt contract: what I did · what I verified · the one thing I need — schema derived from portfolio dogfood runs; honest 'NOT verified' degradation when repo has no tests; Same-provider adversarial review lane (different tier + adversarial role prompt); completion-ledger discipline port (absence-is-death, fake-green guard, tri-state exits, boundary fixtures); Engine model access: SUBSCRIPTION-PRIMARY per the OPERATOR RULING of 2026-08-01 (see Change log fold + § Decisions — supersedes the 2026-07-29 ToS NO-GO reading) — the user's OWN Claude subscription powering the agent they themselves invoke, local MCP topology, no developer credentials anywhere in the path; the API-key seam (TypeScript Agent SDK, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`) is ENGINEERED AND READY as the fallback per β 7c4e2b96's auth-agnostic requirement — if Anthropic closes or meters the subscription path (policy explicitly in flux; enforce-without-notice reserved; residual recorded in the fold), the flip is a seam swap, not a rework; onboarding needs NO Console-account step in the primary path (the guided API-key checklist ships as the fallback flow); env passing to child processes is allowlist-based and ambient credentials (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, OAuth state) are NEVER inherited (a stray env key silently bills the wrong org); ELI5 voice rule in all agent/receipt output; 'Vlad (AI)' attribution hygiene; lightweight terms covering prompt-injection risk + liability
- **Out of scope:** Daemon / proactive loop (nightly audits, morning notes, standing agenda) — Later/paid tier; Hosted engine variant + claude.ai-web support — Later; Cross-provider gauntlet + multi-provider deep research — premium tier (transferability insight 2: sold as MORE reviewers, never 'reviewers that work'); Owned channels (email-out, reply parsing, dashboard chat) — Later; Proxy billing / prompt secrecy — parked as future ENTERPRISE move; Multi-job parallelism + worktree collision layer — Later (v1 = single active job); Account/team shared-control model — whoever prompts Vlad controls Vlad; Vlad creating or deleting accounts/projects — ABSOLUTE refusal lines (thin by ruling; everything else permission-gated); Growth/audience suite as a shipped layer — SCAFFOLD in-repo; do not promise; Cost estimates in proposals — ruled out; warn+confirm on enormous jobs only
- **Current state:** Planned
- **Percent completion:** 0% — conservative; plan authored, no sprints landed.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] One installer command on a clean machine (Windows + macOS) installs agent + engine + .mcp.json entry, and @vlad responds in Claude Code with the init flow — no manual config edits
- [ ] Job #1 (read-only readiness audit) completes on a non-WarpOS repo and returns a receipt (what I did / what I verified / one thing I need) inside 10 minutes
- [ ] The ported audit engine runs clean on ≥3 registered portfolio repos (dogfood corpus) with zero WarpOS-specific refusals, and exactly ONE readiness number exists in the product repo: `score.js` adopted, the checklist proxy NOT ported, the FOUNDERS_CHECKLIST-dependent dimension re-sourced or honestly NOT SCORED — enforced by a check that fails the build if a second readiness number appears (J3: this is an adoption, not a convergence)
- [ ] Every job write lands on a branch; apply = preflight + ff-only merge of the pre-verified commit; a conflicting concurrent edit parks the job as a draft PR instead of applying; undo = one revert — each proven by an automated test
- [ ] approve_job is enforced in engine code: a test that drives run_job to a write-capable step WITHOUT an approval record fails closed; permission level 'auto' short-circuits approval ONLY for grant-covered actions
- [ ] Job state machine + on-disk journal: killing the editor mid-job leaves the repo clean, and next-session get_status names the interrupted job with resume/discard options — proven by test
- [ ] Roadmap job turns the audit's gap report into ROADMAP.md + sprint plan files written into the user's repo; the files survive engine uninstall
- [ ] Engine memory persists per-project across sessions, keyed path-primary; a moved folder is detected and offered relink
- [ ] Receipts and agent output pass an ELI5 spot-check rubric (non-technical, short); 'Vlad (AI)' attribution present in all owned-channel output
- [ ] A recorded end-to-end demo exists: install → init → audit → roadmap on a real non-WarpOS repo (the blog post's evidence)
- [ ] Credential custody proven by a FAIL-CLOSED automated enforcer (not a report-only check): **the product never becomes a credential intermediary** — the HELD SECRET (per β 7c4e2b96's generic-secret design: the user's OAuth/subscription ambient state under the 2026-08-01 subscription-primary ruling; the user's API key on the fallback seam — the control guards WHICHEVER secret the seam carries) is used solely as the SDK/agent's own authentication to Anthropic's endpoint and reaches NO other destination (no log, no telemetry, no proxy, no third party, no child process; env passing allowlist-only). REWORDED 2026-07-30 per β `7c4e2b96` (see Change log): the prior "never leaves their machine / no transmit" form was unachievable as written — the SDK authenticates WITH the key, so transmitting it to Anthropic is the mechanism, not a leak. The enforcer proves three things: no key-shaped secret in the scanned surface; every child-spawn passes an explicit allowlist env AND raw `spawn`/`exec`/`fork` bypassing the audited wrapper is refused; a runtime decoy-key negative fixture goes RED if the scrub is removed. Product-layer control — it ships to and runs on the user's machine. Basis: the twice-verified legal page bars credential intermediation directly (the earlier "Consumer Terms forbid credential sharing" citation was never primary-source verified and is not relied on)

## Decisions
- **2026-08-01 — OPERATOR RULING: model access is SUBSCRIPTION-PRIMARY** ("We are in the clear. It's literally their subscription using an AGENT. And in most cases local MCP."), superseding the 2026-07-29 ToS NO-GO forced consequence. Operator's parse: the prohibition bars DEVELOPER credentials proxying users' requests, not a user running a local agent on their own subscription; supported by Anthropic's support page (third-party SDK usage currently draws from subscriptions; metering change paused June 2026). API-key seam stays ENGINEERED AND READY as the fallback (β 7c4e2b96 auth-agnostic design — the flip is a seam swap). Residual risk recorded, not softened, in the 2026-08-01 Change-log fold: alternative parse available; policy in flux; enforce-without-notice. Parallel work item: the Anthropic clarification/approval request. This RESTORES the grill-r3 frictionless onboarding.
- BYOK/their-account billing; proxy = future enterprise (grill r3) — collapses packaging to plain node
- Package deal: ONE installer, agent hard-requires engine (r1/T2)
- Claude Code = v1 certified host (r2)
- Write path: branch-isolated, preflighted ff-only apply, draft-PR park on any doubt, revert undo (r4, DoE cure, transferability insight 5)
- Permission levels propose-only→auto, per-project config, approval checked in code (r3/F3.4 + F2.3)
- Single active job per project; parallel jobs = Later (r4, α delegated ruling)
- Roadmap/sprint planning ships FREE in v1; vigilance (daemon re-ranking) is premium (r6)
- State stays engine-side; deliverables (ROADMAP.md etc.) are ordinary files in their repo (r6)
- ELI5 voice always; audience = non-technical vibe-coder founders ('past-Vlad') (r2/r3)
- No cost estimates; warn+confirm on enormous jobs (r3)
- Thin absolute refusals: never CREATE accounts / never DELETE accounts or projects; all else permission-gated; browser-driving IN scope with do-it-with-me at credential fields (r4)
- Prompt-injection residual: terms disclosure, not in-your-face UX; proposals cite their evidence (r4)
- Same-provider adversarial review in v1; cross-provider = premium 'more reviewers' (r5, transferability insight 2)
